youtubeTitle: Born blind in poverty, he captained India to two cricket World Cups.
caption:
Born blind in poverty, he captained India to two cricket World Cups.

Shekhar Naik was born blind to a poor family in Shimoga, Karnataka; a childhood surgery later restored partial vision in one eye. He went on to captain India's blind cricket team to World Cup titles in the 2012 T20 World Cup and the 2014 ODI World Cup, scoring 134 off 58 balls in the 2012 final. In 2017, he became the first blind cricketer to receive the Padma Shri.
